Data.title: Duty-Paid Releases Of Liquors, Monthly
Data.footnote: Data refer to gross quantities released.

row.footnote: Refers to sparkling wine of fresh grapes.
Refers to still wine of fresh grapes.
Includes other wine of fresh grapes flavoured with plants or aromatic substances.
Include grape must and mixtures of fermented beverages and non-alcoholic beverages.
Include other spirits obtained by distilling grape wine or grape marc, and arrack and pineapple spirit.

From Jan 2022, 'other duty-paid releases of liquors' includes alcoholic preparations used for the manufacture of alcoholic beverages in liquid or other forms.  Prior to 2022, it also covered bitters, shandy, toddy, vermouth, mead, other fermented beverages and other spirituous beverages, though breakdown for these categories were not available.
